title: New project
subtitle: Choose a source. After import, Polixor analyzes the video – audio, transcript, faces, facecam and interesting moments – and then you choose what to create.

drop.title: Drag a video file here
drop.formats: MP4, MKV, MOV, WEBM and more. The file stays on your computer.

url.label: Video link
url.hint: YouTube, Twitch (VOD, clip or live channel), Kick, Google Drive or a direct file link.
url.noPreview: The link was recognized. No preview information came back – the network may be blocking access to the site.

liveCapture.title: Record from a live stream
liveCapture.body: Polixor will record the stream for the time you choose, then analyze the recording like any video.

liveMonitor.body: Alternatively: continuous monitor mode – records continuously and creates clips while the stream runs (the previous live-stream screen).

section.toggle: Import only part of the video
section.hint: Useful for long videos: only the selected range is downloaded and analyzed.
section.required: The video is longer than {{hours}} hours – choosing a range is required.
section.invalid: The range must be at least 5 seconds, in the format 1:23:45.

projectTitleHint: Optional. Defaults to the video title.
vocabularyHint: Names, nicknames, slang or game terms that come up in this video, one per line or separated by commas. They help recognition; nothing is replaced automatically.
contentLanguageHint: Affects transcription, content analysis and subtitle direction.
nextHint: Analysis starts right away. You can switch to other projects meanwhile.

rights.title: Content you are allowed to edit
rights.body: Polixor does not bypass DRM, private videos or access restrictions. Use your own content or content you have permission to use.
